candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Text fully accurate, furigana correctly attached (遂(と), 排除(はいじょ), 先入(せんにゅう)). Both word boxes rendered as tables. Section 7 blanks inside parentheses shown as underscores, although the image has empty space there. 均等法(きんとう) attaches furigana to the whole word rather than 均等 only.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text and furigana accurate; Section 7 blanks kept as spaces, as in the image. But both boxed word lists are plain space-separated lines, losing the box/table structure. Headings are split from their instructions, and items lack blank lines so they would run together when rendered.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Furigana misplaced twice: 'やり遂げた（と）あとには' puts と after げた instead of after 遂, and '先入（　）（せんにゅう）' puts the reading after the blank. Tables present. Underscores added inside Section 7 parentheses; box shown as ［　］. Preserves original line breaks mid-sentence.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Accurate text and furigana; tables for both boxes. Underscores added inside Section 7 parentheses where the image has only blank space. Uses ## headings with bold nested inside, which is slightly redundant. 均等法(きんとう) furigana span is slightly imprecise.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Accurate throughout. Section 7 blanks kept as spaces, matching the image. Tables for both boxes. The only candidate with the precise furigana span 均等(きんとう)法. ## headings with nested bold are a minor quirk.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the body text completely and without kanji or kana errors, so the ranking turns on furigana placement and layout fidelity. E is best: it keeps the Section 7 blanks as empty space as in the image, uses tables for both boxes, and is the only one to attach きんとう to 均等 alone. A and D are nearly identical and very good, but both add underscores inside the Section 7 parentheses; A is placed ahead because D's ## headings with nested bold are a little further from the original layout. B has clean text but drops the box/table structure and its lines would merge when rendered. C is last because it misplaces furigana in two places (遂げた（と）, 先入（　）（せんにゅう）), which are real accuracy errors.
